callForPapersDescription:
The TWNOG6 Program Committee is now seeking contributions for presentations for the TWNOG6 Conference.

Please submit via the APNIC Paper Submission System at: https://submission.apnic.net/user/login.php?event=213
recommendedTopicsIntro: The following are recommended topics, but not limited to:
recommendedTopicsList: Network Security and Attack Protection: NSP-SEC, DDoS trend, Anti-Spam, Botnet detection, DNS / DNSSEC, Network Infrastructure and Software-Defined Networking

IPv4 / IPv6 Routing and Operations, IPv6 used in different industries, v6 deployment & transition, Internet backbone operations, Access and Transport Technologies (3G/LTE/5G, FTTH, Wireless, Metro Ethernet, Fiber Optics, MPLS), SDN & NFV, RPKI & ROA, Satellite Networks, Affordable Network, Data Center
Energy Utilization: Operations Management, Data Center Certification, Wireless and Mobile Communications
5G/6G related topics: Network Operations and Management
ISP and Carrier services: AI used in Network Operations, Best Practice in Network Operations, Network Performance Measurement, Cloud and Content Delivery Networks (CDN)
Cloud Computing and CDN: Multicast, Voice, Video, Telepresence, Gaming, Emerging Technologies and Others
Big Data, AI, IoT and Industry 4.0, Other Network-Related Topics
cfpSubmissionDescription:
Draft slides MUST be provided with CFP submissions otherwise the submission will be rejected immediately. For work in progress, the most current information available at the time of submission is acceptable.

All draft and complete slides must be submitted in PDF format only. Slides must be of original work, with all company confidential marks removed. Presentations with commercial/sales content will NOT be accepted.

Final slides are to be provided by the specified deadline for publication on the TWNOG website.
contactInfo: Any questions or concerns should be addressed to the Program Committee Chairs by e-mail at paper@twnog.net.
closingRemark: We look forward to receiving your presentation proposals.
